ai_hints: Shell: unquoted variables, missing `set -euo pipefail`, commands that behave differently when a variable is empty (rm -rf $DIR/), parsing ls output, unsafe temp files, curl|sh, secrets echoed to logs, non-portable bashisms under #!/bin/sh.

message.es: Si la variable está vacía borra / o el directorio equivocado. Usa "${VAR:?}" y rutas explícitas.
message.en: If the variable is empty it deletes / or the wrong directory. Use "${VAR:?}" and explicit paths.
